common.tagline: See every defect. Speak every language.

marketing.heroTitle: Cognex-grade defect detection, at a fraction of the cost
marketing.heroSubtitle: Real-time surface defect inspection that runs on the cameras you already own. Live in 15 minutes. No vision engineer required.
marketing.trustLine: Benchmarked on the NEU Surface Defect Database — 73.6% mAP@0.5 at 2.1 ms per frame.
marketing.how1Body: Any USB or IP camera on the line. No new hardware, no rewiring.
marketing.how2Body: One POST request per frame, or run detection in the browser at the edge.
marketing.how3Body: Bounding boxes, defect class and confidence in under a second.
marketing.feature1Body: Detection happens in the operator's browser, so frames never leave the plant and a dropped internet link doesn't stop the line.
marketing.feature2Body: Every screen switches between English and Simplified Chinese instantly — one deployment, two languages.
marketing.feature3Body: REST API, signed webhooks and CSV export. Works with your MES, your ERP, or your spreadsheet.
marketing.feature4Body: Per-inspection pricing you can read off a page. No hardware quote, no lock-in.
marketing.compareManualPain: Slow, inconsistent, a full-time salary per shift
marketing.compareVisionPain: $30k–$80k of hardware plus a vision engineer to configure it
marketing.compareNothingPain: Defects reach the customer and returns damage the relationship
marketing.compareUsWin: Works with existing cameras, live in 15 minutes, from $49/month

pricing.title: Pricing that scales with your line
pricing.subtitle: Start free for 14 days. No card required.
pricing.overage: Then {price} per extra inspection — never cut off mid-shift.

auth.signInSubtitle: Use your work email or a Google account.

auth.otpBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
auth.otpInvalid: That code is not valid or has expired. Request a new one.

onboarding.title: Set up your first line
onboarding.step1Body: Give the camera line a name you'll recognise on the dashboard.
onboarding.step2Body: This picks the defect classes the model looks for.
onboarding.step3Body: Copy this now — it is shown once and cannot be retrieved later.

dashboard.title: Live inspection feed
dashboard.subtitle: Results appear here as your line runs.
dashboard.noInspections: No inspections yet. Send your first frame to /api/v1/inspect, or start the edge inspector below.
dashboard.overageWarning: You are over your plan limit. Extra inspections bill at {price} each.
dashboard.trialExpired: Your trial has ended. Upgrade to keep inspecting.

edge.title: Edge inspector
edge.subtitle: Runs the model in this browser. Frames never leave the plant, and detection keeps working if the internet drops.
edge.noCamera: No camera available. Grant camera permission, or use the REST API instead.
edge.notSupported: This browser cannot run edge inference. Use a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.
edge.uploadResultsHint: Only the detection result and a small thumbnail are uploaded, never the full frame.
edge.modelMissing: No model is deployed yet. Add weights to enable edge inference.

trends.title: Defect trends
trends.subtitle: Where your defects are coming from, over time.
trends.reliabilityNote: Model reliability varies by class. Crazing and rolled-in scale are the hardest classes — treat low-confidence hits on those as a prompt to look, not a verdict.

reports.title: Compliance reports
reports.subtitle: Inspection evidence formatted for ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 audits.
reports.cpkNote: Estimated from the observed defect rate; not a substitute for a dimensional capability study.
reports.proOnly: Compliance export is available on Pro and Enterprise plans.
reports.pilotBody: Shows how many defects were caught over the pilot period and what they would have cost to ship.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: Keys authenticate calls to /api/v1/inspect.
apiKeys.label: Label
apiKeys.newKeyBody: Copy it now. For your security we store only a hash, so this is the only time it can be shown.
apiKeys.confirmRevoke: Revoke this key? Any device using it will stop working immediately.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Plan, usage and invoices.
billing.confirmCancel: Cancel your subscription at the end of the current period?
billing.paystackNote: Paystack accepts Nigerian cards, bank transfer and USSD.
billing.noBilling: Billing is not configured on this deployment.
billing.pastDueWarning: Your last payment failed. Update your payment method to avoid interruption.
billing.manualAccess: Your account has complimentary {tier} access until {date}.
billing.alipayBody: For customers in China. Scan the code, pay the monthly amount, and include the reference in the transfer note.
billing.alipayStep1: Open Alipay and scan the code.
billing.alipayStep2: Enter the amount for your plan and paste the reference into the note.
billing.alipayManualNote: Alipay payments are confirmed by hand, so your plan is activated after we see the transfer — usually within one business day. Card payments activate immediately.
billing.alipayQrMissing: The payment QR code could not be loaded. Check ALIPAY_QR_URL.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Who can see and manage this account.
team.confirmRemove: Remove this teammate from the organization?
team.onlyOwner: Only an owner can change team membership.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Integrations and alerts.
settings.webhookBody: We POST every inspection result to this URL so your MES or ERP does not have to poll.
settings.webhookSecretHint: We sign each request with HMAC-SHA256 in the X-ZemaInspect-Signature header. Verify it before trusting the payload.
settings.alertsBody: Alert us when the defect rate crosses this threshold in any one-hour window.
settings.thresholdHint: 5 means alert above a 5% defect rate.
settings.languageBody: Your choice follows you across devices.

admin.title: Admin
admin.grantAccessBody: Use this for pilot factories you are managing by hand, before self-serve billing.
admin.impersonateWarning: You are viewing {org} as a read-only admin. Every action is logged.
admin.noAccess: You do not have access to this area.
admin.usersSubtitle: Everyone who can sign in, across all organizations.
admin.tempPasswordBody: Give this to the user. It is shown once — they should change it after signing in.
admin.confirmDisable: Disable this account? They will be signed out and cannot sign back in.
admin.newOrgHint: Leave as-is to give them their own organization on a trial.
